<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Foreign policy and regional ties:</strong> Prime Minister Modi highlighted that India&#x27;s &quot;Act East Policy&quot; has provided new momentum to relations with ASEAN during the 23rd India-ASEAN Summit in Manila, while a parliamentary panel has outlined a foreign policy agenda for 2026-27 focusing on Pakistan ties and UN reforms.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQRGNsbG9zLVBRcnBLZ29teWZzYTJic0hkeEY1eVpQZHJYRFBGajlReUFqV05xaHl0SGxfdkYwZkNIcTUzaTByY0FBVDR0N0VGRnhBR0lkSG9IcWhWWE9RTVFTSk9uN1dDdk1Ra204aGlIaldiVnFDZ1VaZWVCQ2tYYTlyLWpCWVJv?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNZ0FjQ0ltMTh2cHY1WENRMmJrV3FFcXNCTjNtd0RhUDR5V25IamxBc1J2aUFTVmUwaFBwRTRUZDRzQjRaOGN0aEpma1pqZWhwSG9DdHBHSUFGRTF5OVA0UzVrZkFZejFNWkNzT2NOVW9YZHdqUlZRaUNIb0RKTTg0R1V3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>

  <li><strong>Women in governance:</strong> Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla inaugurated the first Commonwealth Women Parliamentarians India Regional Conference in Bengaluru, emphasizing the need for increased women&#x27;s representation from panchayats to Parliament.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google._?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
